verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs explicitly state it is open-source and offers a free MIT-licensed Docker Compose self-host deployment (posthog-docs-14, posthog-docs-21), directly satisfying the self-hosting story. Community evidence corroborates real-world self-hosting attempts (posthog-comm-7), though it flags a Docker production issue, indicating some friction. Missing for 10: no independent, recent hands-on report confirming smooth self-host of the full product suite (vs. just core), and no detail on parity between cloud and self-hosted feature sets.
